inputs = {}

def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def body(name):
    p = ROOT / name
    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), name
    b = p.read_bytes()
    inputs[name] = {'path': name, 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': sha(b), 'custody': 'inspected local input; immutable Git pin where explicitly recorded'}
    return b

def read(name):
    b = body(name)
    if name.endswith('.gz'):
        decoded = gzip.decompress(b)
        inputs[name].update(decoded_bytes=len(decoded), decoded_sha256=sha(decoded))
        b = decoded
    return json.loads(b)

def git_json(pin):
    b = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), 'show', pin['commit'] + ':' + pin['path']], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
    assert len(b) == pin['bytes'] and sha(b) == pin['sha256'], pin['path']
    inputs[pin['path']] = dict(pin, custody='immutable selected-source Git pin authenticated during preservation')
    return json.loads(b)

assert not os.path.lexists(OUT), 'Fresh output destination required'

assert len(targets) == 26
peers = []
for o in [35609, 35754]:
    loc = locations[o]
    peers.append({'id': loc['id'], 'pixelIndex': o, 'name': loc['name'], 'province_id': loc['province_id'], 'selected_feature_reference': feature_refs[loc['id']], 'retained_metadata': metadata(features[loc['id']]), 'role': 'retained topology/source context; no new native adjudication'})
parent_ids = set(PROVINCES + [x['province_id'] for x in peers])
parents = [{'id': x['id'], 'name': x['name'], 'parent_id': x['parent_id'], 'source': x['metadata'].get('source'), 'framework_status': x['metadata'].get('framework_status'), 'semantic_action': x['metadata']['semantic_review']['action'], 'boundary_status': x['metadata']['semantic_review']['boundary_status']} for x in hierarchy if x['id'] in parent_ids]
